verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a direct accounting integration: transactions export with reference IDs and offer 'one-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero.' That claim appears only on the Instant Pay (stablecoin payments) page, and it describes one-click rather than clearly automatic or continuous sync. Nothing shows card expenses or receipts flowing to the ledger. CSV export and APIs are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic or recurring sync rather than one-click, explicit coverage of card expenses and receipts beyond Instant Pay transactions, setup or field-mapping documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can sync transactions and expenses automatically with my accounting software

citations.quote: Every transaction exports with reference ID, timestamp, and on-chain hash. One-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero.
